split_rule: One unconditional random permutation of original 61813 non-test rows; calibration first 7726, validation next 7726, train remainder. No stratification, category constraints, or seed selection.
diffusion_selection: minimum RMSE of M=50 validation MC mean; common validation seeds across candidate checkpoints; no calibration/test selection
scope: New fitting/calibration pipeline isolates calibration. Historical development reused these data; this does not erase historical selection or establish conditional-noise assumptions.
preprocessing: Train-only quantile transform of numeric covariates; train-only category vocabulary plus fixed reserved unknown index; train-only response scaler.
test_policy: All four original test files copied byte-for-byte; hashes checked before and after. Test row order immutable. Old paper response SD is used only for reporting metrics.
